verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show Marlin runs autonomously for up to ~8 hours on a research topic, forming hypotheses and producing a full report without further human input (docs-1, docs-9, docs-10, docs-16, docs-25). However, there is no explicit evidence of a notification mechanism alerting the analyst when the job completes, nor details on how results are delivered/accessed asynchronously. Missing for 10: explicit notification/alert feature when job finishes, evidence of async job status/dashboard, independent confirmation of unattended completion reliability.
